title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:

java,spring boot,microservices,event-driven architecture,restful web services,ci/cd,devops,jenkins,docker

title: Fashion Merchandiser
description:
**Industry:**
AI / Fashion Technology / Apparel Manufacturing

**Department:**
Product & AI Solutions

**Years of Experience:**
3+ years

**Salary:**
40k/month take home, 5 LPA CTC

**Job Location:**
Coimbatore

**Work Mode (WFO / WFH / Hybrid):**
Hybrid

*This is a contracted role for 6 months, post which contract will be extended upon evaluating performance*

About Elimai.ai

Elimai.ai is an AI-native enterprise technology company building intelligent AI agents for the fashion and apparel industry.

Our platform helps apparel manufacturers and exporters streamline product development, sampling, costing, pre-production approvals, and merchandising workflows. By automating email processing, technical document interpretation, approval tracking, and manual Excel updates, we help teams improve productivity, reduce errors, and gain real-time operational visibility.

We are now expanding our solutions to support fashion brands, buying offices, and sourcing organizations, enabling seamless collaboration across the fashion supply chain.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

Why Join Elimai.ai?

* Contribute directly to AI products built specifically for the apparel industry.
* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.
* Help shape technology for fashion brands, sourcing offices, and manufacturers.
* Play a meaningful role in transforming traditional fashion supply chain workflows through AI.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.
* Identify differences between brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising operations.
* Document industry terminology, business processes, approval requirements, and operational challenges.

**2. Brand-Side Sourcing & Merchandising Workflows**

* Map how fashion brands manage seasonal collections, product development calendars, style development, and sourcing activities.
* Explain vendor selection, quotation comparison, target costing, and supplier coordination processes.
* Understand how brands coordinate with multiple factories and track product development progress.
* Identify operational challenges in brand-to-manufacturer communication, sample management, and approval tracking.

**3. AI Product Development & Workflow Automation**

* Collaborate with AI engineers and product teams to convert merchandising processes into software requirements.
* **Identify repetitive manual activities suitable for AI-driven automation.**
* Help design AI agents for sampling, costing, technical document processing, approvals, and workflow tracking.
* Validate AI-generated information against actual apparel industry practices.
* Define business rules, workflow exceptions, and scenarios requiring human intervention.
* Provide practical feedback to improve product accuracy, usability, and industry relevance.

**4. Product Testing & Validation**

* Develop realistic merchandising scenarios using tech packs, email conversations, costing sheets, approval documents, and WIP trackers.
* Test AI product features from the perspective of merchandisers, sourcing professionals, and product development teams.
* Identify incorrect interpretations, missing information, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

**5. Customer & Product Collaboration**

* Participate in product discussions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions with apparel manufacturers, buying offices, and brands.
* Understand customer workflows and translate operational requirements into actionable product improvements.
* Work with internal teams to prioritize features based on business value and user needs.
* Support the development of relevant industry use cases and product demonstrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Strong practical experience in apparel product development, technical merchandising, sourcing, or buying-office operations.**
* **Good understanding of end-to-end garment development, from initial design brief to bulk production approval.**
* Ability to read and interpret tech packs, BOMs, measurement charts, specifications, and technical comments.
* **Familiarity with brand-to-vendor communication, development calendars, and production handoff processes.**
* Experience working with merchandising trackers, Excel-based WIP reports, and product development documentation.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex garment industry processes clearly to non-fashion professionals, including software engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with a fashion brand, buying office, sourcing organization, or global apparel exporter.
* Experience coordinating product development across multiple factories or suppliers.
* Familiarity with PLM, ERP, or other apparel industry software platforms.
* Experience creating SOPs, process maps, training materials, or workflow documentation.
* Prior involvement in software implementation, process digitization, or automation projects is an advantage.

*Prior AI or software development experience is not mandatory. Strong apparel industry knowledge and the ability to explain business workflows are more important.*

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Help Elimai.ai develop a comprehensive understanding of brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising workflows.
* Translate real-world apparel processes into clear, actionable requirements for AI product development.
* Improve the accuracy and practicality of Elimai's AI-powered merchandising solutions.
* Identify high-value opportunities to automate repetitive work while retaining essential human decision-making.
* Help build products that apparel brands, buying offices, and manufacturers can confidently use in their daily operations.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Quality Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Java Full Stack Development

Spring Boot

15 years full time education
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches — writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Hands-On Technical Contribution
  
  
Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction.
  
  
Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment.
  
  
Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly.
  
  
Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment — not just review others' work.
  
  
Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards.
  
  
Actively use and champion AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow.
  
  
Technical Leadership
  
  
Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling.
  
  
Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct.
  
  
Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team.
  
  
Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment.
  
  
Team Management & Delivery:
  
  
Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself.
  
  
Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching.
  
  
Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions — and then build them yourself.
  
  
Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability.
  
  
Required Qualifications:
  
  
7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.
  
  
Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development — you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past.
  
  
Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
  
  
Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills — query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently.
  
  
Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments.
  
  
Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.
  
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred).
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  
OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience.
  
  
Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns.
  
  
Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

title: TECHNICAL LEAD - ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY & AI
description:
TECHNICAL LEAD -- ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY & AI

Company: Haiintel | Location: Coimbatore / Hybrid / Remote

Experience: 10+ Years

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Haiintel is an AI and technology engineering company specializing in enterprise-grade solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, Cloud Computing, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Blockchain, and Digital Transformation. We partner with enterprise clients to solve complex technology challenges requiring strong architectural thinking, deep engineering expertise, and independent technical leadership.

JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly intelligent, technically strong, and execution-oriented Technical Lead to independently own complex enterprise projects. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep architectural expertise, team guidance, and direct client engagement. The ideal candidate will take complete technical ownership from problem understanding through production delivery, work with minimal supervision, and make critical technical decisions independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Ownership & Architecture

● Take end-to-end technical ownership of assigned enterprise projects

● Design scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable enterprise solutions

● Lead system architecture, API design, data architecture, system integration, and technology stack decisions

● Create HLDs/LLDs and comprehensive technical documentation

● Review existing architectures and identify modernization and optimization opportunities

● Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Engineering Leadership & Execution

● Lead and mentor engineering teams across multiple technology stacks

● Provide technical direction through rigorous design reviews and code reviews

● Resolve complex engineering challenges and critical production issues

● Establish engineering standards, best practices, development processes, and quality benchmarks

● Remain hands-on to investigate and solve critical technical problems when required

● Ensure solutions achieve the right balance of technical quality, development speed, and scalability

Client & Stakeholder Management

● Act as the senior technical representative and point of contact with enterprise clients

● Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions, architecture design discussions, and solution assessments

● Directly engage with senior client stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams

● Translate complex business and functional requirements into practical technical solutions

● Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

● Independently manage technical discussions, escalations, and decision-making

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Professional Experience

● 10+ years of professional software engineering and system development experience

● Proven experience as Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, or Solution Architect

● Demonstrated experience owning complex, mission-critical enterprise applications or platforms

● Successfully taken projects from architecture and design through production deployment

● Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with varying levels of expertise

Technical Competencies

● Deep knowledge of system design, architecture patterns, and distributed systems

● Strong backend/server-side software engineering fundamentals

● Extensive hands-on experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud-native architecture

● Strong foundation in microservices architecture, APIs, databases, and data systems

● Solid knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code

● Understanding of security best practices, IAM, authentication/authorization, and API security

Core Competencies & Attributes

● Exceptional problem-solving ability - can break down complex, ambiguous problems and derive practical solutions

● Strong architectural thinking - understands complete system requirements while maintaining implementation depth

● Complete ownership mindset - takes responsibility for technical outcomes without waiting for detailed instructions

● Client maturity and confidence - can effectively represent the organization before senior enterprise stakeholders

● Sound technical judgment - can independently evaluate alternatives, understand trade-offs, and make critical decisions

● Technical adaptability - can quickly learn new technologies, understand unfamiliar domains, and work with existing systems

● Strong communication skills - can articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

PREFERRED TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE

● AI & Modern Technology: Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG systems, knowledge graphs, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks

● Cloud Platforms: GCP (strongly preferred), AWS, Azure - with deep hands-on experience

● Architecture & Design: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design

● Databases & Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery, or equivalent data platforms

● Engineering Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, IaC tools, monitoring and observability solutions

Note: Deep hands-on expertise across multiple areas is more valuable than superficial knowledge of many technologies. Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, Go, Node.js, .NET, or equivalent) is essential.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE & SPECIALIZATIONS

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly valued:

● Generative AI / Agentic AI systems and implementations

● FinTech, Payment Systems, or High-Volume Transaction Systems

● Enterprise SaaS or large-scale B2B platforms

● Large-scale modernization or digital transformation initiatives

● Data-intensive platforms or analytics systems

● Blockchain or distributed ledger technologies

title: Java Module Lead
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

  

  





**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India**
  

  

  

 With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.
   

  

  

  

 The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.
   

  

  

  

 You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

  

  

 This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write
 **production code every day** 
 , and you will lead by building the hardest parts yourself.
 



 It is
 **not a management role** 
 . There is no team to administer, no appraisal cycle, no delivery meetings in place of engineering. If you have moved away from daily coding, this role will not suit you.
 



  





**Our Primary tech stack:** 



* React
* React Native
* Python
* Salesforce
* Cloud\-native, across all major clouds
* An agentic layer running through all of it
* Whatever else the client needs



  





**What you will own:** 



* **The build.** 
 Production code every week, on the parts that matter most. Design, write, review, ship.
* **Agentic systems.** 
 LLM\-driven features running in production for clients. Agents, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and the cost and latency behind each choice.
* **The technical standard.** 
 Design and code reviews for two or three engineers working alongside you.
* **Delivery.** 
 Scope, estimate, sequence and commitment date. When a date is at risk you raise it before it moves.
* **Technical discussions with clients.** 
 Requirements, trade\-offs, and what is possible by when.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 6–8 years in software engineering, hands\-on throughout
* Python, with production depth
* React, and React Native for mobile
* Cloud in production on AWS, Azure or GCP, deployed and operated by you
* Production code written in the last 90 days
* An LLM or agent feature you have built and shipped to production
* Experience leading engineers technically, through reviews, standards and design decisions
* Delivery ownership: you have carried a date and answered for it
* Able to work hybrid from Coimbatore



  





**Preferred:** 



* Both startup and large\-organisation experience
* Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* You follow the field closely and form views by building with new models and tooling rather than reading about them
* Salesforce
* Client\-facing experience, in India or abroad



  





**Process:** 




 Screening call, technical discussion, delivery and leadership conversation, offer. We aim to close within two weeks of first contact.
